snippet.title: Cyber Rail - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Cyber Rail, a first-person cyberpunk Western roguelike shooter developed by Torn Ace Studios. Players will master movement mechanics to grapple, slide, and swing across a suite of platforms to take out enemies along the way. Take out robot cowboys, make use of powerful weapons, and attain upgrades from run to run. Cyber Rail is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam.
